option_a_explicit_sparse.reason: The measured 162.43-s jacfwd covers only seven global directions. Explicit local SQP also needs 252 shooting-state directions on this smallest problem, plus residual Jacobians and a KKT solve.

option_b_matrix_free.reason: One exact forward-mode JVP costs 137.19 s. A Gauss-Newton/KKT Krylov product also needs a VJP; even three products would consume essentially the full ten-minute gate before nonlinear trial evaluations.
